


The LEC 2026 season kicks off with the special LEC Versus tournament from January 17 to March 1, 2026, featuring LEC teams plus two ERL (Regional League) guests, followed by the standard Spring and Summer splits with their own dates yet to be announced but expected to run through the year. The main season starts January 17, 2026, with the Versus event concluding March 1st, and the full season will have Spring and Summer components following that. 
LEC Versus 2026 (Early Season Event)
Start Date: January 17, 2026 (Regular Season begins)
End Date: March 1, 2026 (Playoffs conclude)
Format: A unique 12-team tournament with regular season and playoffs. 
Full LEC 2026 Season 
Spring Split: Dates TBA, follows LEC Versus.
Summer Split: Dates TBA, last split of the season. 
In short, the action begins mid-January 2026 with a special event, leading into the traditional Spring and Summer splits for the rest of the year. 


The 2026 LCK season kicks off with the LCK Cup 2026 from January 14 to March 1, 2026, serving as the preseason tournament, with the main LCK Spring Split likely following in late March/early April, similar to prior years, leading to the major LCK Summer Split later in the year. 
Key Dates & Tournaments:
LCK Cup 2026 (Preseason): January 14 – March 1, 2026.
LCK Spring Split (Main Season): Expected to begin in late March 2026 (following the Cup).
LCK Summer Split (Main Season): Expected to run from June/July to August/September 2026 (typical schedule). 
What to Expect:
The LCK Cup features the ten Korean teams in a preseason format, with playoffs culminating on March 1st.
The main LCK season (Spring & Summer) will follow, with traditional splits and championship playoffs. 


In the current LEC Versus 2026 format's regular season, there are six matches per game day, all played as best-of-one (Bo1) series. 
The LEC typically schedules its game days on weekends, usually Saturday and Sunday, though this can vary depending on the specific split or playoff schedule. You can find the exact dates and match-ups on the official LoL Esports schedule.
